finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:41` — it computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the spec's own comment ("discount first, then tax on the discounted amount"). Most order-total test rows had a zero discount or zero tax, which masked the bug; only 3 rows with both non-zero exposed it. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
